caption:
France enters recession after GDP falls 0.2% in third quarter

The country has now posted two consecutive quarters of negative growth. France's national statistics bureau reported the figure for the third quarter of 2026. The bureau had previously reported stagnation for the quarter.

Reported by Le Monde in English.
